reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that monitors account balance and per-session token usage, presenting both in a dedicated Settings → Quota section.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置中展示账户额度和当前会话 Token 用量。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek account quota and current-session token usage in the DeepSeek Harness web settings.

capabilities: Queries the DeepSeek balance endpoint using configured credentials
Displays account quota and current-session token usage in the web settings interface
Registers a read-only same-origin host route and a settings section
